title: Enter the Necropolis of the Via Triumphalis
description: Take the official guided route through a terraced Roman cemetery, with tomb inscriptions recalling people beyond the imperial elite. Book the chosen tour through the Vatican Museums and confirm its entrance, fee and current dates; the standalone route uses Porta di Santa Rosa.

title: Visit the Teutonic Cemetery in its morning access window
description: Ask the Swiss Guard for access to the small historic cemetery during its stated morning window. Wednesday entry may be unavailable when a papal audience is held.

title: Send a postcard through Vatican Post
description: Write a memory of your visit and send it through the Vatican postal service near Bernini's colonnade. Allow for postcard and postage costs, and check current counter hours before relying on a particular branch.
